identity.affine_arithmetic: Arb encloses c0+exact_delta*v and alpha0+exact_delta*w before all fixed base weights
identity.parameter_arithmetic: First form complete exact center and direction scalar polynomials; then add the single p in [-eta,eta]. No independent raw-control parameter intervals are introduced.
identity.exact_delta_fraction_scope: The exact_delta_fraction field names the center only; all bounds cover the separately stated whole exact_parameter_interval.

exact_source_partition: strict scalar source f=f*1_(r<0)+f*1_(r>=0), as an L1 density; source signs and graph extensions reflect with the complete equation

ordinary_source_spaces.strict_core: L1(dr; H_N^(-1/2)) of the original physical scalar f
ordinary_source_spaces.left_canonical_root: L1(dxi; H_N^(-1/3)) of the exact canonical ordinary source on a valid extension
ordinary_source_spaces.left_tilted_graph: L1(dt; H_N^(-1/2)) of the same extended source after the exact tilted graph change
ordinary_source_spaces.right_canonical_root: the corresponding right canonical ordinary-source norm
ordinary_source_spaces.right_tilted_graph: the corresponding right tilted-graph ordinary-source norm
